extension.summary: Control the LG webOS TV that Kodi runs on
extension.description: Power, volume, mute, inputs, apps, sound output, remote buttons and toast notifications for LG webOS TVs over the local SSAP API. Publishes live TV state as skin properties (Window(Home).Property(WebOS.*)) and exposes every action through RunScript, keymaps and JSON-RPC. Works with Kodi running on the TV itself or on another box on the LAN.
